## API

Everything below is imported from `@nanahoshi/mona-ui/qr-code`. Each name links to its reference page, with every input, output, property and method.

| Name | Kind | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| [`QrCodeComponent`](/api/qr-code/QrCodeComponent) | Component | Draws a value as a QR code in SVG, and exports it as a PNG, SVG or PDF file. |
| [`QrCodeExportError`](/api/qr-code/QrCodeExportError) | Class | The error a QR code export rejects with. |
| [`validateQrCodeValue`](/api/qr-code/validateQrCodeValue) | Function | Checks whether a QR code can hold a value with the given settings, without drawing it: every character has to fit the encoding, and the whole value the largest code. |

### Types

| Type | Kind | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| [`QR_CODE_DEFAULT_MESSAGES`](/api/qr-code/QR_CODE_DEFAULT_MESSAGES) | Constant |  |
| [`QrCodeDownloadOptions`](/api/qr-code/QrCodeDownloadOptions) | Interface | What to export a QR code as, and the name of the file to save. |
| [`QrCodeExportOptions`](/api/qr-code/QrCodeExportOptions) | Interface | What to export a QR code as. |
| [`QrCodeExportResult`](/api/qr-code/QrCodeExportResult) | Interface | An exported QR code. |
| [`QrCodeImageOverlay`](/api/qr-code/QrCodeImageOverlay) | Interface | An image, such as a logo, drawn over the center of the code. |
| [`QrCodeSwissOverlay`](/api/qr-code/QrCodeSwissOverlay) | Interface | The Swiss cross of a Swiss QR code, the code on a Swiss QR-bill, drawn over the center at the size the standard sets. |
| [`QrCodeTooLongError`](/api/qr-code/QrCodeTooLongError) | Interface | A value too long for the largest QR code (version 40) at the chosen error correction level. |
| [`QrCodeUnsupportedCharacterError`](/api/qr-code/QrCodeUnsupportedCharacterError) | Interface | A character the chosen encoding can't store, such as `€` in `"iso-8859-1"`. |
| [`QrCodeValidationOptions`](/api/qr-code/QrCodeValidationOptions) | Interface | The settings a value is checked against, matching the component's inputs of the same names. |
| [`QrCodeEncoding`](/api/qr-code/QrCodeEncoding) | Type alias | The character set a QR code stores text in. - `"utf-8"`: any text. |
| [`QrCodeErrorCorrection`](/api/qr-code/QrCodeErrorCorrection) | Type alias | How much of the code can be damaged or hidden and still read: about 7% at `"L"`, 15% at `"M"`, 25% at `"Q"` and 30% at `"H"`. |
| [`QrCodeExportErrorCode`](/api/qr-code/QrCodeExportErrorCode) | Type alias | Why a QR code export failed. - `"not-ready"`: there's no code to export, because the value is empty or can't be encoded. - `"unsupported-environment"`: the export ran outside a browser, such as during server-side rendering. - `"invalid-size"`: the size isn't a positive number, or a PNG of that size can't give each module a pixel. - `"resource-load-failed"`: the overlay image didn't load, or another origin didn't allow reading it. - `"png-rasterization-failed"`: the browser couldn't draw the PNG. - `"pdf-generation-failed"`: `jspdf` isn't installed, or failed to write the page. |
| [`QrCodeExportFormat`](/api/qr-code/QrCodeExportFormat) | Type alias | The file a QR code exports to: a `"png"` image, an `"svg"` document or a `"pdf"` page. |
| [`QrCodeOverlay`](/api/qr-code/QrCodeOverlay) | Type alias | What to draw over the center of the code. |
| [`QrCodeValueError`](/api/qr-code/QrCodeValueError) | Type alias | Why a value can't be stored in a QR code. |

**Related types:** [`MonaQrCodeMessages`](/api/i18n/MonaQrCodeMessages)
